title: Trump administration suspends Microsoft's ability to apply for green cards, alleging fraud
description: The tech giant is no longer able to apply for H1-B visas for employees who come to live and work in the United States, potentially stymieing Xbox hiring.

title: Xbox CEO unveils 'new Xbox division' for game-adjacent ventures named 'XP'
description: Xbox is doubling down on its more IP-centric strategy with a division dedicated to expanding those properties outside of games.

title: Denuvo attempts to subpoena Discord, Valve, and Reddit in effort to identify hacker
description: After numerous and consistent cracks over the last year, Denuvo wants to find the hacker that has compromised its security through other online platforms.

title: Star Wars Zero Company developer Bit Reactor brings back 'over half' of furloughed staff
description: The studio suspended the majority of its staff ahead of the tactical Star Wars title's launch. Now it's bringing back many suspended employees.

title: Former Activision Blizzard CEO Bobby Kotick named to the board of post-merger Skydance
description: From the convergence of Paramount and WB comes a newly-formed company that has tapped Kotick to sit on its board.

title: Electronic Arts' leveraged buyout faces a bondholder battle
description: The acquisition of Electronic Arts required taking on a lot of debt, and some bondholders are reportedly demanding more cash.

title: Unity unveils Unity Spark, an prompt-based tool for Google's AI game platform
description: Unity's new tool allows prompt-based game development, working in collaboration with Google AI.

title: Google debuts new 'experimental' AI game platform named Google Playground
description: A platform for people who want to play games made by AI.

title: GameStop, other retailers to sell used PlayStation 5 Pro units for 66 percent over MSRP
description: The advanced PlayStation 5 console is already both highly sought-after and hard to find. Now retailers are pricing it well above MSRP.

title: Undead Labs studio head says they were 'irresponsibly transparent' in preparing staff for layoffs
description: Studio head Philip Holt says he was being incredibly candid with employees as layoffs loomed.

title: Co-dev case study: How Blackbird Interactive and Secret Mode helped Escape the Backrooms ride the Backrooms hype wave
description: A co-dev partnership helped Fancy's hit game Escape The Backrooms reach over 4 million players.

title: Arc Raiders and The Finals set for TV and film adaptations from Backrooms co-producer
description: The Sweden-based Embark Studios has secured adaptations for both of its multiplayer shooters, The Finals and ARC Raiders.

title: Report: Ninja Theory lays off workers after failing to spin off from Xbox
description: The developer of the Hellblade titles and the recently-announced Senua is reportedly cutting jobs after attempts to divest the studio from the parent company were unsuccessful.

title: Why it's still worth making immersive sims ft. Harvey Smith & Ben Horne
description: Celebrated game designer Harvey Smith and former Arkane Austin executive producer Ben Horne lay out their vision for Black Pony Immersive.

title: Reigns developer Nerial enters 'hibernation mode,' lays off staff
description: The studio that gave birth to Reigns is ending operations—for now.

title: 100 Steam Games that started life during GMTK Game Jam
description: There are more than 100 games on Steam that started life during one of our GMTK Game Jam events. To celebrate these amazing developers, let's look at 100 games that made the jump from jam to Steam.

title: How I Coded the Perks in my Roguelike
description: Word Play is my vocabulary roguelike, with over 100 passive perks. Implementing them into the game meant learning a whole new type of coding architecture: inheritance.

title: The Secrets Behind THAT Cyberpunk 2077 Montage
description: Here's a super quick bonus video, looking at the famous montage from Cyberpunk 2077. How did CD Projekt Red make a cinematic sequence with 15 location changes, 79 cuts, and three mirror shots? Let's find out.

title: How Rockstar fit an entire city into PlayStation 2 memory
description: With Grand Theft Auto III, Rockstar North performed a magic trick: it squeezed an entire 4 kilometre wide city into the tiny 32 megabyte chip of the PlayStation 2. Here's how they did it.

title: Has Zelda Changed Forever?
description: The Legend of Zelda series turns 40 years old this month. Let's look at the two distinct eras of the franchise, ask why Nintendo made the shift, and look at what might come next.

title: The World Design of Hollow Knight: Silksong
description: Team Cherry returns to the world of Hollow Knight with Silksong - a new game, with a new character, in a whole new world. In this episode of Boss Keys let's look at how the developers designed Pharloom and the Citadel, and how they thought about topics like progression, backtracking, and optional content.

title: What's the Point of Prototyping?
description: With a game idea under your belt, it's time to test it out. And the best way to do that is with a prototype. Find out why, and get tips for making your own, in episode two of Game Dev 101.

title: How Games Do Destruction
description: Let's talk about video game destruction, and break down the techniques used to dent cars, break boxes, tear through scenery, and blow up buildings.

title: What's The Point Of Hard Games, Anyway?
description: Hollow Knight: Silksong is the latest game to join the "difficulty in games" debate. In this Mini episode of GMTK, let's look at why, and how, designers implement a high level of challenge in their games.

title: My Favourite Games from GMTK Game Jam 2025
description: This year's GMTK Game Jam was all about loops. Here are 20 of my favourite entries to the jam - from programming chefs to time-travelling crows.
